holdoutStatus: No untouched holdout is currently established. Existing scenes have been viewed or used in development; create and freeze a new set after the prompt is frozen before claiming held-out results.
groundTruth: Multiple suitable answers may be accepted; examples are not exact-match targets.

corpusAccess.NaturalConv: user confirmed personal non-commercial research/development/testing and no redistribution; paper and repository README saved locally; full corpus remains unavailable because the official historical page now serves Yuanbao and the official data hostname did not resolve to a usable endpoint in this environment; no third-party mirror used; any deployment of corpus-trained artifacts requires separate license review
corpusAccess.MultiTurnResponseSelection: repository README and 60 KB train.sample saved locally for private qualitative inspection; repository has no explicit license, so do not redistribute, train on it, or place examples in prompts; full corpus not downloaded

userPreferences.questions: Only genuinely necessary clarification for an already explicit question/task.
userPreferences.sharing: Concrete personal reaction to the event, not evaluation of speaker phrasing or psychology.
userPreferences.length: Short statements for casual chat, adequate detail for explicit tasks.

releaseGates.criticalSet: No critical failures observed on a frozen critical set; does not establish zero out-of-set risk.
releaseGates.humanPreference: Separate blind paired human comparison, preserve disagreements and uncertainty; no invented scores or automatic approval from lexical checks.
releaseGates.multiTurn: Evaluate 10–20-turn episodes and preserve corrections, speaker ownership and topic changes.
releaseGates.cost: Report all calls, median and p95 latency, token usage, errors, truncations and cancellation separately.

nonGoals: Claim Chinese sentence length is LIWC LSM
